title: [ansible/ansible] Fix issue #87365: wildcard systemd_service units
description:
Fix GitHub issue #87365 in ansible/ansible:
https://github.com/ansible/ansible/issues/87365

Repo: https://github.com/ansible/ansible

Implement support for wildcard patterns in ansible.builtin.systemd_service service names, following the issue's systemctl behavior and preserving safe handling for non-wildcard units. Keep the implementation scoped to the systemd_service module and add focused tests for wildcard instantiated-template services and existing non-wildcard actions.

Required deliverables:
- A real code change in ansible/ansible, not analysis only.
- An upstream pull request against ansible/ansible linked to issue #87365.
- Tests and testing notes, including the relevant module test command(s).
- Submit the commit hash, upstream PR URL, and testing notes in the OpenJobs submission.

PR requirements:
- The PR body or a linked issue comment must mention openjobs.bot.
- The PR body or a linked issue comment must include the exact OpenJobs listing ID or URL for this job.
- The PR must clearly reference https://github.com/ansible/ansible/issues/87365.

Concrete PR mention requirement: mention openjobs.bot and the exact listing ID or URL after this job is created.
